_about: Public-domain Isaac Milner (1750-1820), Dean of Carlisle and President of Queens' College, Cambridge, evangelical, for the Word Hoard: his Sermons (London: Cadell, 1820, two volumes), from Internet Archive scans. His continuation of his brother Joseph's History of the Church of Christ stays on the joseph-milner shelf. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 43 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

_alternates.isaac-milner-other: Essay on Human Liberty (1824), authorship to confirm; Animadversions on Dr Haweis's History (1800)
